g.text: Restaurant Rush - class diagram, detail 4 of 4: customers, orders and the menu (tag stage-3)
Boxes without compartments are detailed on another page.
+onServed(order : Order, turn : int, log : TurnLog) : void
+onServed(order : Order, turn : int, log : TurnLog) : void
~Order(customer : Customer, item : MenuItem, price : Money, placedTurn : int)
No class checks a customer's type. lossPerTurn(),
priceFor() and onServed() are dispatched to the
subclass: a VIP pays 10% less and loses 5 per waiting
turn; a Critic loses 12 and takes -20 when served more
than one turn after the dish became READY.
The status-changing methods of Customer, Order and Table
and Restaurant's seat, placeOrder and serve are
package-private (~), and they check their preconditions
caller can put an object into an invalid status. Query
methods return unmodifiable lists. The Order constructor
no code outside the entity package can create an order,
and in the game only Restaurant.placeOrder() does, locking
A ComboMeal is a MenuItem made of two MenuItems and
delegates to them: prepUnits = sum of the parts,
price = 90% of their total. Order only sees MenuItem,
so combos needed no change there. The parts are shared
(Salad is sold alone and is in two combos), so this is
Immutable value in integer cents. The constructor
Visibility: + public, - private, # protected, ~ package-private. Underlined = static, italic = abstract.
«final» = final class, {leaf} = final method, {readOnly} = constant, [0..1] = may be null, (+) = nested class.
«record»: components are private final fields with public accessors of the same name.
Associations are drawn without arrowheads: each is navigable from the class holding the field named on the line
(both ways for "Customer sits at Table" and "Customer places Order"). Those fields also appear as attributes,
except that Money values and the fields of records are shown as attributes only.
Dependencies: «create» instantiates, «use» calls, «throw» / «catch» an exception. Drawn for creations and
for calls that carry a game rule or appear in the sequence diagram; plain getter reads are not drawn.
Not drawn: record accessors, equals/hashCode/toString of records, enum values()/valueOf(),
This page also leaves out simple getters (a method named after the field it returns), but keeps overrides
such as Dish.price(); class-diagram shows every getter. Only the links of this page's classes are drawn.
